info.title: MMSPro API
info.description:
REST API for MMSPro — maintenance management platform.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Supabase JWT in the `Authorization` header:
`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

Obtain a token by signing in through the client app (Supabase Auth).

## Public endpoints
- `GET /health`
- `POST /api/auth/password-reset`
- `GET /api/docs` and `GET /api/docs/openapi.json`
